lead: Mamata Banerjee is an Indian politician, born on 5 January 1955 in Kolkata.
As of 2026, she is 71 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.
She has held the office of Member of the 8th Lok Sabha and Member of the 10th Lok Sabha and has been recognised with CNN-News18 Indian of the Year and Time 100.
This profile collects the Mamata facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Mamata Banerjee — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mamata Banerjee was born on 5 January 1955 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality.
She received her education at University of Calcutta, Shri Shikshayatan College, Jogamaya Devi College and Jogesh Chandra Chaudhuri Law College.
She is recorded as speaking English and Bangla.

sections.heading: Mamata Banerjee — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician, painter and poet as her occupations.

She has held the following offices: Member of the 8th Lok Sabha (1984–1989), Member of the 10th Lok Sabha (1991–1996), Member of the 11th Lok Sabha (1996–1997), Member of the 12th Lok Sabha (1998–1999), Member of the 13th Lok Sabha (1999–2004) and Minister of Railways (1999–2001). She is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
